title: Government's Obligation to Prescribe Salaries and Allowances

content.scenario: The Government of India is setting up a new District Commission under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. The officers and employees of the Commission need to be paid salaries and allowances. The Government must prescribe the salaries and allowances payable to them.
content.outcome: The Government shall prescribe the salaries and allowances payable to the officers and employees of the District Commission, as per the provisions of Section 33(3) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What are the obligations of the Government regarding salaries and allowances of District Commission officers?
How are salaries and allowances of consumer protection officers determined?
What is the role of the Government in prescribing salaries and allowances?
